property_summary: For any caller, calling sendMoney(target, value, data) must not change the contract's ability to withdrawAll (i.e., the contract's balance must be withdrawable only by the owner); the mutant that removes onlyOwner allows non-owner calls to affect withdrawAll observable state (owner-only protection is broken), so there exists inputs where post-sendMoney the ability to withdrawAll differs.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), permitting anyone to call withdrawAll and thus altering withdrawAll observable behavior.
